prompt:
PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY - SINGLE OBJECT
One shallow ceramic dish, 15cm diameter, circular with raised rim, matte B4C technical ceramic. Centered in frame, fully visible, immediately readable as manufactured tableware.

OBJECT DEFINITION
Single engineered ceramic dish with distinct rim, concave bowl surface, and circular outer edge. Full object silhouette clearly defined against background. No ambiguity, no abstract pattern, no wall texture.

COMPOSITION
Product photography framing. Object centered, 70% of frame. Full silhouette visible from rim to base. Clean separation from background. Shot from 30-degree elevated angle showing dish interior and rim profile.

MATERIAL
Matte B4C technical ceramic, porcelain-white #FAFAFA. Subtle eggshell texture visible on curved surface. Zero gloss, zero specular highlights. Cold industrial ceramic read. Non-plastic, non-PVC, non-toy material.

LIGHTING
Low-key studio lighting. Directional light creating defining shadow on one side. Highlights rim curvature and bowl depth. No ambient wash, no magenta, no neon.

BACKGROUND
Minimal dark concrete surface, out of focus secondary to subject.

COLOR
Subtractive mineral palette. Low saturation. Shadow-dominant 70%. Warm off-white ceramic with subtle temperature variation in shadows.

QUALITY
Commercial product photography. 8K detail. Industrial design aesthetic. Crisp readable object., one single main subject only, subject must occupy clear central frame presence, object/entity must be fully readable, abstract composition, atmospheric-only image, empty scene as final subject
